raw_comment:
1. The worst droughts seem to be roughly concentrated near the middle of the country. Alaska seems mostly unaffected by drought. 
2. How does this map compare to those showing heat waves and wildfires? What geographic characteristics do the regions most impacted by droughts have in common? Where are the major agricultural areas and how are they impacted by this?
3. One of my primary hobbies is gardening, so I’ve noticed that my area has been especially dry lately. Knowing about precipitation levels can help choose more drought-resistant strains to plant.
4. All Dried Up- A Closer Look at Drought Across the States
